When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life

1531-2527-4076-4279-4549.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1531-2527-4076-4279-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6529-8100.easyPrerequisites:

When the fetched land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1734-3817-4247.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1363-1636-1778.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Memnite.
You control at least one additional creature,
1363-1636-1778.description:
Cast Memnite by paying its mana cost.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Memnite and one other creature you control, returning Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1363-1636-1778.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

3532-5078-6595-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6595-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyxe Hext's prowess ability and Elena trigger.
Resolve the Elena trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4228-7124-7653.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
4228-7124-7653.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker, triggering the ability given to it by Bear Umbra, untapping all lands you control.
During the end of combat step, activate Desert's second ability by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and then untapping it and causing you to gain an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

206-2457-4289-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4605-5147-6132-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2933-4013-5798-7175.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

527-969-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

444-1423-2894-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
444-1423-2894-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Golgari Grave-Troll. Then, the draw will be replaced by Golgari Grave-Troll's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Golgari Grave-Troll from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

643-2366-5414-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
643-2366-5414-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2366-3499-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.

2366-3499-5234-5702.description:

When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1739-4013-4659-5004-6643.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

465-5686-6132.description:

When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-3558-5220-6900.description:

When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2105-4068-6911.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
2105-4068-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2639-3254-4050-6708.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-6708.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Zephyr Sentinel and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Zephyr Sentinel enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Zephyr Sentinel and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-6708.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

339-677-2438-4068.description:

Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

542-3617-6333.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{B} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn

1571-1990-5728-5929.description:

Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

678-2921-4192-5659-5753.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5231-5663--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.

1569-2232-2983-3806.description:

3817-5170-5256.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
3817-5170-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.

When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield, and causing you to gain 5 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 2.

Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Abdel Adrian's toughness.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.

Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Phyrexian Delver to return to the battlefield from exile.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose five life.
Repeat from step 2.

313-2034-3503-4067.description:

Resolve the Spectral Arcanist trigger, casting Corpse Dance from your graveyard with buyback by paying {2}.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Spectral Arcanist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Spectral Arcanist enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Mind over Matter by discarding Corpse Dance, untapping any applicable permanent.
Repeat from step 3.

Twilight Shepherd enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.

Resolve the Twilight Shepherd trigger, returning to your hand all cards that were put into your graveyard this turn.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.

Twilight Shepherd enters the battlefield, returning to your hand all cards that were put into your graveyard this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

147-536-2320.notablePrerequisites: Other lands that can produce {3}{U}{R}{R} on the battlefield.
147-536-2320.description:
During an opponent turn, after their upkeep, cast Reset for {U}{U}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage at instant speed for {1}{R}{R}.
Resolve Dualcaster Mage, and target Reset with his triggered ETB ability to copy Reset.
Resolve the Reset copy untapping your lands including Riptide Laboratory.
In response to the original Reset still on the stack, activate Riptide Laboratory's activated ability for {1}{U} and tap targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Riptide Laboratory's activated ability returning Dualcaster Mage to your hand.
Tap all lands other than Riptide Laboratory.
Repeat.
